title: DX Bootcamp Pipeline & Initiative Heatmap
creator: Lena Thompson
description:
Goal: Build a repeatable DX ‘bootcamp’ pipeline and a live initiative heatmap to accelerate SDK adoption, streamline quickstart creation, and make docs improvements trackable against OKRs.

Scope:
- Define a 6-week bootcamp template (onboarding sequences, hands-on labs, sample apps, evaluation prompts).
- Create editorial pipeline for 1-pager quickstarts + runnable repo templates.
- Instrument each asset with activation metrics (first call, first embed, retention).
- Publish an initiative heatmap UI (console + internal dashboard) that maps DX assets to company OKRs and cycle-level targets.

Success metrics (OKR-aligned):
- +30% week-1 activation rate for new accounts using SDK quickstarts by end of Q1.
- 12 published quickstarts with runnable repos and CI tests.
- Heatmap coverage: 90% of DX initiatives tagged to an OKR and cycle.
- Reduce time-to-first-success (TTFS) from signup to sample-run from 24h -> <4h for bootcamp participants.

Deliverables:
- Bootcamp playbook (confluence) + 3 canonical bootcamp modules.
- 6 quickstart repos with templates (GitHub org) and CI smoke tests.
- Heatmap prototype (internal dashboard) with filters for cycle, owner, and metric status.
- Runbook for maintenance on a quarterly cadence.

Risks & trade-offs:
- Heavy initial engineering effort to add instrumentation to SDKs; deferred work may slow rollout.
- Over-indexing on quantity of quickstarts vs. quality; plan includes editorial QA gate.
- Heatmap surface area may require console engineering time; prototype will ship as an internal dashboard to validate product assumptions before console work.

Rollout plan:
1) Nov: finalize playbook + prototype heatmap dataset (telemetry + tagging schema).
2) Dec: produce 3 quickstarts and bootcamp module alpha; run internal pilot with Solutions.
3) Jan: publish public repos, wire basic CI, collect initial metrics, iterate.
4) Feb: expand heatmap into console scope and prepare cross-functional comms.

Acceptance criteria:
- Playbook reviewed and approved by PM, Design, and Eng (review comments resolved).
- At least 3 quickstarts pass CI and have reproducible instructions.
- Heatmap displays live metrics for pilot assets and can be filtered by cycle and OKR.

Artifacts & links:
- Confluence: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/DX/Bootcamp+Playbook
- Quickstart repos (examples): https://github.com/redwood-inference/dx-quickstart-node, https://github.com/redwood-inference/dx-quickstart-python
- Prototype heatmap dashboard: https://grafana.redwood.ai/d/bootcamp-heatmap

Notes: This ticket focuses on the program/initiative layer — measuring impact across multiple assets — not the full console UX. Console work will be a follow-up once we validate the heatmap dataset and metric definitions.
